svg.title: The status of an order, as orders.get and orders.list read it
svg.desc: An order reads in_progress until it reaches an ending; once it is paid and handed to your handler it is on the list of open orders. It closes as delivered, or shipped for a parcel, when the goods or the shipment are recorded and the money moved, and as rejected, expired or cancelled when nothing was charged. Two statuses stay on the open list after the purchase itself is over: refund_due, when the buyer was charged and has no goods, and delivered_unpaid, when you delivered a synchronous order and the charge failed; that buyer has no goods and has paid nothing. payment_unresolved means nobody knows whether the charge went through; it is on the open list only after a synchronous delivery, and a late answer from the facilitator moves it to delivered, delivered_unpaid, refund_due or rejected. A late delivery turns refund_due into delivered; a repeat purchase that pays turns delivered_unpaid, or a synchronous order that expired while your goods were on the way, into delivered. Nothing records a refund yet, so no order reaches refunded.
